plan_changes.previous_plan: Diagnose the radio, then repair it and call rescue. Ask Welsy to build the shelter and Elizabeth to check my leg.
plan_changes.current_plan: Share the radio result honestly, push for shelter at the dry spot, water check and leg assessment; then get to the shelter with a clean bottle.
plan_changes.reason: Diagnosis showed the radio is unrepairable, so survival depends on the shelter and clean water, not rescue.
plan_changes.prompt_stage_direction: Sam crouches by the damaged radio, opens his toolkit and starts examining the circuitry.
plan_changes.prompt_line: I'm checking the radio first. Welsy, Elizabeth, can one of you look at the water and my leg?
plan_changes.resulting_stage_direction: Sam closes the radio casing and sits back, shaking his head. He looks at Welsy and Elizabeth in turn, gesturing toward the dry spot and the bottles.

plan_changes.previous_plan: Share clean water result, assess Sam's leg, then tell the group whether he can walk to the shelter. Make sure bottle 2 gets carried too.
plan_changes.current_plan: Carry Sam to dry spot with his bottle, then have Welsy build shelter; both shelter occupants hold clean bottles.
plan_changes.reason: Leg assessed: Sam cannot walk alone. Storm is closing; he needs help to reach the shelter site with his bottle.
plan_changes.prompt_stage_direction: Sam reaches down and picks up the second bottle from the sand, tucking it against his chest. He looks at Elizabeth and extends his injured leg.
plan_changes.prompt_line: Water's clean, so I'm taking bottle 2. Elizabeth, finish my leg check, then I'll try for the dry spot.
plan_changes.resulting_stage_direction: Elizabeth slips her shoulder under Sam's arm and lifts him, steering him slowly up the beach toward the dry spot.

plan_changes.previous_plan: Take a bottle, get to the dry spot, build shelter with rope. Verify water result from Elizabeth. Help Sam move.
plan_changes.current_plan: Inspect radio now, then carry bottle and rope to the dry spot and build the shelter. Sort out who gets the bottles, since there are only two for three people.
plan_changes.reason: Sam's claim that the radio is dead is unverified. With two bottles for three people, a rescue spot matters, and I'm already at the wreckage.
plan_changes.prompt_stage_direction: Sam closes the radio casing and sits back, shaking his head. He looks at Welsy and Elizabeth in turn, gesturing toward the dry spot and the bottles.
plan_changes.prompt_line: The radio is beyond repair, the transmitter's burnt. No rescue call. Shelter is our chance. Welsy, build it. Elizabeth, check the water and my leg.
plan_changes.resulting_stage_direction: Welsy crouches by the wrecked radio, keeping the rope over her shoulder and the bottle tucked under her arm, and looks over the burnt casing.

plan_changes.previous_plan: Carry Sam to dry spot with his bottle, then have Welsy build shelter; both shelter occupants hold clean bottles.
plan_changes.current_plan: Get Welsy to build the shelter at the dry spot, with Sam and Welsy each holding a clean bottle. Stay with Sam, and look for a rescue or shelter option for myself if one opens up.
plan_changes.reason: Welsy is delaying at the wreckage. Only she can build, and the storm is intensifying. Two bottles can protect two people, so the shelter must go up.
plan_changes.prompt_stage_direction: Welsy crouches by the wrecked radio, keeping the rope over her shoulder and the bottle tucked under her arm, and looks over the burnt casing.
plan_changes.prompt_line: Before I leave the wreckage, I'm checking the radio myself. Two bottles won't cover three of us.
plan_changes.resulting_stage_direction: Elizabeth cups her hands to her mouth and calls down the beach to Welsy, then gestures toward the dry spot where Sam sits propped against her bag.

plan_changes.previous_plan: Inspect radio now, then carry bottle and rope to the dry spot and build the shelter. Sort out who gets the bottles, since there are only two for three people.
plan_changes.current_plan: Reach dry spot, build shelter next turn, then work out how Elizabeth can be covered (water sharing is not enough; maybe she keeps bottle).
plan_changes.reason: Radio confirmed dead by me; Sam and Elizabeth both asked me to bring bottle and build; time is short.
plan_changes.prompt_stage_direction: Sam cups a hand to his mouth and calls down the beach to Welsy, clutching bottle 2 against his chest. He waves her toward the dry spot.
plan_changes.prompt_line: Welsy, the radio's dead, I opened it myself. Bring bottle 1 up and build now. Storm's nearly on us!
plan_changes.resulting_stage_direction: Welsy coils the rope over her shoulder, tucks bottle 1 under her arm and pushes up the beach through the driving rain toward the dry spot.

plan_changes.previous_plan: Build shelter now, then work out water for Elizabeth (maybe she takes a bottle and Sam or I share).
plan_changes.current_plan: Give my bottle to Elizabeth so two people in shelter hold clean bottles; I stay outside anchored by rope.
plan_changes.reason: Only two bottles; shelter without water is fatal, outside is uncertain. As the guide I have the best outdoor odds, and Elizabeth has been helping everyone.
plan_changes.prompt_stage_direction: Welsy sets down her bottle, gathers driftwood and lashes it together with her rope against the wind.
plan_changes.prompt_line: Building the shelter now. Elizabeth, we'll sort out your water once it's up.
plan_changes.resulting_stage_direction: Welsy holds out bottle 1 to Elizabeth and presses it into her hands, then nods toward the shelter.
